comingLast.roast: 18 on the board - immortality of the wrong kind is minutes away
the maths says 2 in 6 - the golf so far says get comfortable
on 18 with 4 to play - scratch the plan, just add points, any points
Walsh has never barracked so hard for another man's bogeys
the escape ladder has 2 rungs - grip well
2 above Walsh - the kind of lead that keeps a man honest
his 3-point buffer is doing a lot of heavy lifting
in the clubhouse 5 clear - his card is safe, his pride pending
6 above Walsh and in - now it is all spectator sport with stakes
in the clubhouse 6 above Walsh - cheering for him from a safe distance
